every named command has an HTTP mapping case or explicit multi-request scenario
invalid browser identity and pagination never reach HTTP
canonical paths and method allowlist reject confirmation bypasses before HTTP
UTF-8 Chinese and emoji survive one-byte response chunks
absolute deadline terminates a continuously trickling response without retry
numeric int64 response IDs are preserved as exact decimal strings
multipart uses streaming, exact Content-Length, and rejects oversized files before sending
ambiguous, missing-value and unsupported options fail closed
release matrix preserves failed, skipped and missing cases instead of manufacturing passes
strict booleans reject typo rather than silently disable resources
desktop status accepts its special health envelope only at /status
invalid and business failure envelopes never report success
sensitive nested keys redacted without altering input or IDs
reject unsafe numeric IDs and remote/non-HTTP transport
defaults allow asynchronous startup and long kernel wait
force stop and generic monthly activation cannot bypass confirmation
named queries redact by default and false is not raw-output
int64 strings preserved in ADB updates, including payload mode
destructive named commands are blocked before HTTP
malformed JSON, missing code and string codes fail CLI
timeout produces unknown-outcome message and never retries automatically
named cloudphone adb-info searches later pages and redacts credentials
repeated pagination is an incomplete result, never a false not-found
async startup acceptance stays distinct from pending, ready and business failure
